summary.en: Bring the work surface and open storage into one study area.
summary.zh: 将工作台面与开放收纳集中到一个学习办公区。

description.en:
A desk arrangement combining a wood-look work surface with dark open framing and shelving. Books, files and everyday desk items can be planned around the same workstation.
Share your available floor space, required tabletop size and packing preferences to define the model you need.
description.zh:
木纹台面搭配深色开放框架及置物架，可围绕同一工作位置安排书籍、文件和常用桌面物品。
请提供可用空间、台面尺寸需求及包装偏好，以便确认具体配置。

en: Worktop and vertical open storage shown together.
Confirm desktop dimensions and assembly requirements before ordering.
zh: 工作台面与竖向开放收纳组合。
下单前确认台面尺寸及组装要求。
